scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['public', 'server/src/public'].forEach(d => { if(fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', d, {recursive:true}); })"
